name: cursor-relay-mcp
description: Durable, model-selected Cursor Agent delegation through MCP.

interface.shortDescription: Delegate durable tasks to a chosen Cursor model.
interface.longDescription: Discover account models and delegate local workspace tasks to Cursor Agent with durable runs, polling, restart recovery, bounded events, timeouts, and structured errors.
defaultPrompt: Use matching permissions, keep polling long Cursor runs, open view_run for live progress, and verify local changes.
